verses.sloka: स हताश्वो महातेजा भूमौ तिष्ठन्निशाचरः।इन्द्रजित् परमक्रुद्धः सम्प्रजज्वाल तेजसा ।। ६.९१.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa hatāśvo mahātejā bhūmau tiṣṭhanniśācaraḥ।indrajit paramakruddhaḥ samprajajvāla tejasā ।। 6.91.1 ।।

translations.english: The nightranger, effulgent Indrajith standing on the ground very angry, with horses lost, was flaming with energy.

verses.sloka: तौ धन्विनौ जिघांसन्तावन्योन्यमिषुभिर्भृशम्।विजयेनाभिनिष्क्रान्तौ वने गजवृषाविव ।। ६.९१.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tau dhanvinau jighāṁsantāvanyonyamiṣubhirbhṛśam।vijayenābhiniṣkrāntau vane gajavṛṣāviva ।। 6.91.2 ।।

translations.english: Exceedingly wanting to kill one another, wielding bows, both sallied forth like Lordly elephants in the forest, to succeed.
translations.hindi: विभीषण ने कहा ) मेघ के समान काली यह; जो राक्षसी सेना देख पड़ती हे इसके साथ वानरों को पेड़ ले लेकर शीघ्र भिड़ जाना चाहिए

verses.sloka: निबर्हयन्तश्चान्योन्यं ते राक्षसवनौकसः।भर्तारं न जहुर्युद्धे सम्पतन्तस्ततस्ततः ।। ६.९१.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: nibarhayantaścānyonyaṁ te rākṣasavanaukasaḥ।bhartāraṁ na jahuryuddhe sampatantastatastataḥ ।। 6.91.3 ।।

translations.english: Moving all over, both Rakshasas and Vanaras killing one another in the battle did not leave their master.
translations.hindi: हे लक्ष्मण! तुम भी इस्रीको तितर बितर करने का यत्न करो ! जब यह सेना तितर वितर हो जायगी तभी इन्द्रजीच तुमको दिखलाइ पड़ेगा

verses.sloka: ततस्तान् राक्षसान् सर्वान् हर्षयन् रावणात्मजः।स्तुवानो हर्षमाणश्च इदं वचनमब्रवीत् ।। ६.९१.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tatastān rākṣasān sarvān harṣayan rāvaṇātmajaḥ।stuvāno harṣamāṇaśca idaṁ vacanamabravīt ।। 6.91.4 ।।

translations.english: Then Ravana's son, praising all the Rakshasas making them happy, spoke these words.

verses.sloka: तमसा बहुलेनेमाः संसक्ताः सर्वतो दिशः।नेह विज्ञायते स्वो वा परो वा राक्षसोत्तमाः ।। ६.९१.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: tamasā bahulenemāḥ saṁsaktāḥ sarvato diśaḥ।neha vijñāyate svo vā paro vā rākṣasottamāḥ ।। 6.91.5 ।।

translations.english: " As all directions are spread with darkness now it is not possible to know who one's own is or others at this time."
translations.hindi: हे वीर ! इस दुरात्मा, मायावी, परम झघासिक, निष्ठुर कम करने वाले और समस्त लोकों को भय देने बाले इन्द्रजोत को सारो

verses.sloka: धृष्टं भवन्तो युध्यन्तु हरीणां मोहनाय वै।अहं तु रथमास्थाय आगमिष्यामि संयुगम् ।। ६.९१.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: dhṛṣṭaṁ bhavanto yudhyantu harīṇāṁ mohanāya vai।ahaṁ tu rathamāsthāya āgamiṣyāmi saṁyugam ।। 6.91.6 ।।

translations.english: "You delude the sight of Vanaras in battle. I will come to the battle taking the chariot."

verses.sloka: तथा भवन्तः कुर्वन्तु यथेमे काननौकसः।न युद्ध्येयुर्दुरात्मानः प्रविष्टे नगरं मयि ।। ६.९१.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: tathā bhavantaḥ kurvantu yatheme kānanaukasaḥ।na yuddhyeyurdurātmānaḥ praviṣṭe nagaraṁ mayi ।। 6.91.7 ।।

translations.english: "While I enter the city you must see that these wicked minded Vanaras do not prevent me from going."
translations.hindi: साथ ही पेड़ों, पत्थरों और नखों से लड्ने वाले रीछों और बानरो ने उस खड़ी हुई राक्षसी सेना पर घावा किया

verses.sloka: इत्युक्त्वा रावणसुतो वञ्चयित्वा वनौकसः।प्रविवेश पुरीं लङ्कां रथहेतोरमित्रहा ।। ६.९१.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā rāvaṇasuto vañcayitvā vanaukasaḥ।praviveśa purīṁ laṅkāṁ rathahetoramitrahā ।। 6.91.8 ।।

translations.english: Ravana's son, a slayer of his enemies, having spoken to Vanaras in that way, in deceiving manner entered Lanka to get the chariot.

verses.sloka: स रथं भूषयित्वा तु रुचिरं हेमभूषितम्।प्रासासिशतसम्पूर्णं युक्तं परमवाजिभिः ।। ६.९१.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa rathaṁ bhūṣayitvā tu ruciraṁ hemabhūṣitam।prāsāsiśatasampūrṇaṁ yuktaṁ paramavājibhiḥ ।। 6.91.9 ।।

translations.english: Ravana's son ascended a decorated chariot yoked to horses, directed by a charioteer who could tender good advice and a knower of the nature of horses. It was a beautiful chariot decked with darts and swords adorned with gold which Ravana's son of extraordinarily bright, who has won enemies, ascended.

verses.sloka: अधिष्ठितं हयज्ञेन सूतेनाप्तोपदेशिना।आरुरोह महातेजा रावणिः समितिञ्जयः ।। ६.९१.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: adhiṣṭhitaṁ hayajñena sūtenāptopadeśinā।āruroha mahātejā rāvaṇiḥ samitiñjayaḥ ।। 6.91.10 ।।

translations.english: Ravana's son ascended a decorated chariot yoked to horses, directed by a charioteer who could tender good advice and a knower of the nature of horses. It was a beautiful chariot decked with darts and swords adorned with gold which Ravana's son of extraordinarily bright, who has won enemies, ascended.
translations.hindi: तरह तरह के शख्ों, पैने पेने तीरों, बड़े बड़े वृच्षों और वदत श्वङ्गां से आकाशमण्डल ढक गया

verses.sloka: स राक्षसगणैर्मुख्यैर्वृतो मन्दोदरीसुतः।निर्ययौ नगरात्तूर्णं कृतान्तबलचोदितः ।। ६.९१.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa rākṣasagaṇairmukhyairvṛto mandodarīsutaḥ।niryayau nagarāttūrṇaṁ kṛtāntabalacoditaḥ ।। 6.91.11 ।।

translations.english: Heroic son of Mandodari, impelled by the force of destiny, departed from the city surrounded by Rakshasas.

verses.sloka: सो ऽभिनिष्क्रम्य नगरादिन्द्रजित् परवीरहा।आभ्ययाज्जवनैरश्वैर्लक्ष्मणं सविभीषणम् ।। ६.९१.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: so 'bhiniṣkramya nagarādindrajit paravīrahā।ābhyayājjavanairaśvairlakṣmaṇaṁ savibhīṣaṇam ।। 6.91.12 ।।

translations.english: Heroic in the act of destruction of enemies, Indarjith having started from the city in his chariot drawn by swift horses assailed Vibheeshana and Lakshmana.

verses.sloka: ततो रथस्तमालोक्य सौमित्री रावणात्मजम्।वानराश्च महावीर्या राक्षसश्च विभीषणः।विस्मयं परमं जग्मुर्लाघवात्तस्य धीमतः ।। ६.९१.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato rathastamālokya saumitrī rāvaṇātmajam।vānarāśca mahāvīryā rākṣasaśca vibhīṣaṇaḥ।vismayaṁ paramaṁ jagmurlāghavāttasya dhīmataḥ ।। 6.91.13 ।।

translations.english: Seeing Indrajith seated in the chariot, great hero Lakshmana as well as the Vanaras and Vibheeshana wondered how easily he went and returned.

verses.sloka: रावणिश्चापि सङ्क्रुद्धो रणे वानरयूथपान्।पातयामास बाणौघैः शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः ।। ६.९१.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇiścāpi saṅkruddho raṇe vānarayūthapān।pātayāmāsa bāṇaughaiḥ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ ।। 6.91.14 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith, highly enraged, struck Vanara leaders with a volley of hundreds and thousands of arrows.
translations.hindi: जब मेघनाद ने वानरों द्वारा अपनी सेना का ध्वस्त होना सुना, तब वह दुर्धेषे उस हवनकभ को अधूरा ही छोड़, उठ खडा हुआ

verses.sloka: स मण्डलीकृतधनू रावणिः समितिञ्जयः।हरीनभ्यहनत् क्रुद्धः परं लाघवमास्थितः ।। ६.९१.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa maṇḍalīkṛtadhanū rāvaṇiḥ samitiñjayaḥ।harīnabhyahanat kruddhaḥ paraṁ lāghavamāsthitaḥ ।। 6.91.15 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith, a winner of combat, became highly furious and stretched his bow showing his skill easily struck at Vanaras.

verses.sloka: ते वध्यमाना हरयो नाराचैर्भीमविक्रमाः।सौमित्रिं शरणं प्राप्ताः प्रजापतिमिव प्रजाः ।। ६.९१.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: te vadhyamānā harayo nārācairbhīmavikramāḥ।saumitriṁ śaraṇaṁ prāptāḥ prajāpatimiva prajāḥ ।। 6.91.16 ।।

translations.english: (The Vanaras), though endowed with prowess and of terrific courage, struck by the Rakshasa, they sought refuge of Lakshmana, their Lord, just as people seek the refuge of their Lord, the creator.
translations.hindi: उस समय वह बड़ा भयानक धनुष हाथ में लिये हुए, प्रलय- कालीन मेघ की तरह ओर क्रोध में भर लाल लाल आंखे किए हुए दूसरे संहारकारी मत्यु जैसा जान पड़ता था

verses.sloka: ततः समरकोपेन ज्वलितो रघुनन्दनः।चिच्छेद कार्मुकं तस्य दर्शयन् पाणिलाघवम् ।। ६.९१.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ samarakopena jvalito raghunandanaḥ।ciccheda kārmukaṁ tasya darśayan pāṇilāghavam ।। 6.91.17 ।।

translations.english: There, in the battlefield the delight of Raghus glowing with anger shattered the Rakshasas showing the skill of his hand s.
translations.hindi: मेघनाद को रथ पर सवार हुआ देख, लक्ष्मण के साथ लड़ती हुई भयङ्कर वेगत्राली राक्षसी सेत मेघनाद के रथ के चारों मर हो गई अर्थात्‌ मेघनाद की रक्षा के लिए उसके रथ को घेर लिस

verses.sloka: सो ऽन्यत् कार्मुकमादय सज्यं चक्रे त्वरन्निव।तदप्यस्य त्रिभिर्बाणैर्लक्ष्मणो निरकृन्तत ।। ६.९१.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: so 'nyat kārmukamādaya sajyaṁ cakre tvaranniva।tadapyasya tribhirbāṇairlakṣmaṇo nirakṛntata ।। 6.91.18 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith seizing another bow hastily targeted at Lakshmana and Lakshmana split them with three arrows.

verses.sloka: अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानमाशीविषविषोपमैः।विव्याधोरसि सौमित्री रावणिं पञ्चभिः शरैः ।। ६.९१.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: athainaṁ chinnadhanvānamāśīviṣaviṣopamaiḥ।vivyādhorasi saumitrī rāvaṇiṁ pañcabhiḥ śaraiḥ ।। 6.91.19 ।।

translations.english: Then Saumithri pierced with five arrows into the chest of Indrajith like a venomous serpent and split the bow.

verses.sloka: ते तस्य कायं निर्भिद्य महाकार्मुकनिस्सृताः।निपेतुर्धरणीं बाणा रक्ता इव महोरगाः ।। ६.९१.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: te tasya kāyaṁ nirbhidya mahākārmukanissṛtāḥ।nipeturdharaṇīṁ bāṇā raktā iva mahoragāḥ ।। 6.91.20 ।।

translations.english: Those arrows released from the great bow of Lakshmana, entered the body of Indrajithand fell on the ground like a huge red serpent.

verses.sloka: स भिन्नवर्मा रुधिरं वमन् वक्त्रेण रावणिः।जग्राह कार्मुकश्रेष्ठं दृढज्यं बलवत्तरम् ।। ६.९१.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa bhinnavarmā rudhiraṁ vaman vaktreṇa rāvaṇiḥ।jagrāha kārmukaśreṣṭhaṁ dṛḍhajyaṁ balavattaram ।। 6.91.21 ।।

translations.english: Bow split, ejecting blood from mouth, Indrajith took his strong best of bows which had a stout string.

verses.sloka: स लक्ष्मणं समुद्दिश्य परं लाघवमास्थितः।ववर्ष शरवर्षाणि वर्षाणीव पुरन्दरः ।। ६.९१.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa lakṣmaṇaṁ samuddiśya paraṁ lāghavamāsthitaḥ।vavarṣa śaravarṣāṇi varṣāṇīva purandaraḥ ।। 6.91.22 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith, aiming at Lakshmana, let loose rain of arrows easily like rain.
translations.hindi: इंसी प्रकार वानर भी उत समर में उन सब वृक्षों और पर्वत शिखरों के प्रहार से, उन प्रधान राक्षसों को, जो उनको मार रहे थे, मारने लगे

verses.sloka: मुक्तमिन्द्रजिता तत्तु शरवर्षमरिन्दमः।अवारयदसम्भ्रान्तो लक्ष्मणः सुदुरासदम् ।। ६.९१.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: muktamindrajitā tattu śaravarṣamarindamaḥ।avārayadasambhrānto lakṣmaṇaḥ sudurāsadam ।। 6.91.23 ।।

translations.english: Lakshmana, the tamer of enemies, without reacting intercepted the shower of arrows released by Indrajith which was difficult to resist.

verses.sloka: दर्शयामास च तदा रावणिं रघुनन्दनः।असम्भ्रान्तो महातेजास्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् ।। ६.९१.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: darśayāmāsa ca tadā rāvaṇiṁ raghunandanaḥ।asambhrānto mahātejāstadadbhutamivābhavat ।। 6.91.24 ।।

translations.english: Highly energetic Lakshmana, a delight of Raghus, unperturbed, demonstrated to Indrajith, which was a wonder indeed.

verses.sloka: ततस्तान् राक्षसान् सर्वांस्त्रिभिरेकैकमाहवे ।। ६.९१.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: tatastān rākṣasān sarvāṁstribhirekaikamāhave ।। 6.91.25 ।।

translations.english: Then extremely angry Lakshmana pierced all the Rakshasas quickly, each one with three arrows and struck them and even the son of Rakshasa king, exhibiting his skills.

verses.sloka: अविध्यत् परमक्रुद्धः शीघ्रास्त्रं सम्प्रदर्शयन्।राक्षसेन्द्रसुतं चापि बाणौघैः समताडयत् ।। ६.९१.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: avidhyat paramakruddhaḥ śīghrāstraṁ sampradarśayan।rākṣasendrasutaṁ cāpi bāṇaughaiḥ samatāḍayat ।। 6.91.26 ।।

translations.english: Then extremely angry Lakshmana pierced all the Rakshasas quickly, each one with three arrows and struck them and even the son of Rakshasa king, exhibiting his skills.
translations.hindi: तब उसने अपने सारथि को आज्ञा दी कि, मेरा रथ वहाँ ले चलो जहाँ हनुमान्‌ जी राक्षसों का नाश कर रहे हें । यदि थोड़ी देर और में उसकी उपेक्षा करूँगा, तो वह मेरे सब राक्षसो को सार डालेगा

verses.sloka: सो ऽतिविद्धो बलवता शत्रुणा शत्रुघातिना।असक्तं प्रेषयामास लक्ष्मणाय बहून् शरान् ।। ६.९१.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: so 'tividdho balavatā śatruṇā śatrughātinā।asaktaṁ preṣayāmāsa lakṣmaṇāya bahūn śarān ।। 6.91.27 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith, who was grievously wounded by his hostile enemy, Lakshmana, the destroyer of hostile enemies, continuously discharged arrows at him.
translations.hindi: इन्द्रजीत के यह कहते ही स.रथि ने वह रथ, जिसमें परम- इच इन्द्रजीत बेठा हुआ था, हॉक कर, वहाँ पहुँचा दिशा, जहां इबुसान जी लड़ रहे थे

verses.sloka: तानप्राप्तान् शितैर्बाणैश्चिच्छेद रघुनन्दनः।सारथेरस्य च रणे रथिनो रथसत्तमः।शिरो जहार धर्मात्मा भल्लेनानतपर्वणा ।। ६.९१.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: tānaprāptān śitairbāṇaiściccheda raghunandanaḥ।sāratherasya ca raṇe rathino rathasattamaḥ।śiro jahāra dharmātmā bhallenānataparvaṇā ।। 6.91.28 ।।

translations.english: Heroic enemy, the righteous Lakshmana, tore the head of the carwarrior as well as the charioteer in the battle with bhala (spear), even before Indrajith discharged pointed arrows at him.

verses.sloka: असूतास्ते हयास्तत्र रथमूहुरविक्लवाः।मण्डलान्यभिधावन्तस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् ।। ६.९१.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: asūtāste hayāstatra rathamūhuraviklavāḥ।maṇḍalānyabhidhāvantastadadbhutamivābhavat ।। 6.91.29 ।।

translations.english: There, though there was no charioteer, the horses went round in circles and as they went forward it was wonderful.

verses.sloka: अमर्षवशमापन्नः सौमित्रिर्द्दढविक्रमः।प्रत्यविद्ध्यद्धयांस्तस्य शरैर्वित्रासयन् रणे ।। ६.९१.३० ।।
verses.transliteration: amarṣavaśamāpannaḥ saumitrirddaḍhavikramaḥ।pratyaviddhyaddhayāṁstasya śarairvitrāsayan raṇe ।। 6.91.30 ।।

translations.english: Saumithri of untiring valour, overcome with fury in the battle, struck the horses to scare them and destroyed them.
translations.hindi: अरे दुबु द्वि रावण के पुत्र! यदि तुमे बीर होने का गब हैँ तो आ लड़ । अब तू पवननन्दन के सामने पड़ कर, जीता हुआ: लोट कर नहीं जाने पावेगा

verses.sloka: अमृष्यमाणस्तत्कर्म रावणस्य सुतो बली।विव्याध दशभिर्बाणैः सौमित्रिं तममर्षणम् ।। ६.९१.३१ ।।
verses.transliteration: amṛṣyamāṇastatkarma rāvaṇasya suto balī।vivyādha daśabhirbāṇaiḥ saumitriṁ tamamarṣaṇam ।। 6.91.31 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith, unable to tolerate the action of Saumithri, was angry and struck him with ten arrows.
translations.hindi: यदि तेरे शरीर में बल हो तो आकर मुझसे मल्लयुद्ध कर (कुश्ती) लड़ । यद्वि तू मेरे बल को सह गया, तो में तुमे बढ़ा बलवान राक्षस सममूगा

verses.sloka: ते तस्य वज्रप्रतिमाः शराः सर्पविषोपमाः।विलयं जग्मुराहत्य कवचं काञ्चनप्रभम् ।। ६.९१.३२ ।।
verses.transliteration: te tasya vajrapratimāḥ śarāḥ sarpaviṣopamāḥ।vilayaṁ jagmurāhatya kavacaṁ kāñcanaprabham ।। 6.91.32 ।।

translations.english: His arrows, which resembled thunderbolts and were like venomous serpents, touching Lakshmana's shield shining like gold, broken, and fallen
translations.hindi: युद्धकाण्डे हनुमान्‌ को मारने के लिए इन्द्रजीत को धनुष उठाए देख कर, लच्मण से विभीषण वोले--हे लक्ष्मण ! देखो, जिस राबण पुत्र ने इन्द्र को परास्त किआ है वही रथ में चढ़ा हुआ, हनुमान्‌ को मारना चाहता हे

verses.sloka: अभेद्यकवचं मत्वा लक्ष्मणं रावणात्मजः।ललाटे लक्ष्मणं बाणैः सुपुङ्खैस्त्रिभिरिन्द्रजित्।अविध्यत् परमक्रुद्धः शीघ्रास्त्रं च प्रदर्शयन् ।। ६.९१.३३ ।।
verses.transliteration: abhedyakavacaṁ matvā lakṣmaṇaṁ rāvaṇātmajaḥ।lalāṭe lakṣmaṇaṁ bāṇaiḥ supuṅkhaistribhirindrajit।avidhyat paramakruddhaḥ śīghrāstraṁ ca pradarśayan ।। 6.91.33 ।।

translations.english: Ravana's son, knowing that it is not possible to break the shield of Lakshmana, quickly showed his weapon with three arrows with plumes and gems and struck him on the forehead.

verses.sloka: तैः पृषत्कैर्ललाटस्थैः शुशुभे रघुनन्दनः।रणाग्रे समरश्लाघी त्रिशृङ्ग इव पर्वतः ।। ६.९१.३४ ।।
verses.transliteration: taiḥ pṛṣatkairlalāṭasthaiḥ śuśubhe raghunandanaḥ।raṇāgre samaraślāghī triśṛṅga iva parvataḥ ।। 6.91.34 ।।

translations.english: Ravana's son, knowing that it is not possible to break the shield of Lakshmana, quickly showed his weapon with three arrows with plumes and gems and struck him on the forehead.
translations.hindi: अतः हे लक्ष्मण ! अब तुम कनेर वृक्ष के पत्तों के आकार वाले, शत्विदीर कारी और शत्रुनाशकारी भयङ्कर बाणों से, इन्द्र- जीत का बध करो

verses.sloka: स तथा ह्यर्दितो बाणै राक्षसेन महामृधे।तमाशु प्रतिविव्याध लक्ष्मणः पञ्चभिः शरैः।विकृष्येन्द्रजितो युद्धे वदने शुभकुण्डले ।। ६.९१.३५ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tathā hyardito bāṇai rākṣasena mahāmṛdhe।tamāśu prativivyādha lakṣmaṇaḥ pañcabhiḥ śaraiḥ।vikṛṣyendrajito yuddhe vadane śubhakuṇḍale ।। 6.91.35 ।।

translations.english: Lakshmana, the delight of Raghus, who loved to fight, looked charming in the battlefield with three arrows stuck on his forehead looking like three mountain peaks.

verses.sloka: लक्ष्मणेन्द्रजितौ वीरौ महाबलशरासनौ।अन्योन्यं जघ्नतुर्बाणैर्विशिखैर्भीमविक्रमौ ।। ६.९१.३६ ।।
verses.transliteration: lakṣmaṇendrajitau vīrau mahābalaśarāsanau।anyonyaṁ jaghnaturbāṇairviśikhairbhīmavikramau ।। 6.91.36 ।।

translations.english: Then in the battle, pierced by Rakshasa in that manner, Laksmana immediately stretched his bow and struck with five arrows on the face of Indrajith, who was adorned with auspicious earrings.

verses.sloka: ततः शोणितदिग्धाङ्गौ लक्ष्मणेन्द्रजितावुभौ।रणे तौ रेजतुर्वीरौ पुष्पिताविव किंशुकौ ।। ६.९१.३७ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śoṇitadigdhāṅgau lakṣmaṇendrajitāvubhau।raṇe tau rejaturvīrau puṣpitāviva kiṁśukau ।। 6.91.37 ।।

translations.english: Both heroes of extraordinary might and equipped with huge arms, endowed with terrific valour, Lakshmana and Indrajith struck one another with sharp arrows.

verses.sloka: तौ परस्परमभ्येत्य सर्वगात्रेषु धन्विनौ।घोरैर्विव्यधतुर्बाणैः कृतभावावुभौ जये ।। ६.९१.३८ ।।
verses.transliteration: tau parasparamabhyetya sarvagātreṣu dhanvinau।ghorairvivyadhaturbāṇaiḥ kṛtabhāvāvubhau jaye ।। 6.91.38 ।।

translations.english: Then smeared with blood the two, Lakshmana and Indrajit, shone like fully blossomed Kimsuka in battle.

verses.sloka: ततः समरकोपेन संयुक्तो रावणात्मजः।विभीषणं त्रिभिर्बाणैर्विव्याध वदने शुभे ।। ६.९१.३९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ samarakopena saṁyukto rāvaṇātmajaḥ।vibhīṣaṇaṁ tribhirbāṇairvivyādha vadane śubhe ।। 6.91.39 ।।

translations.english: Both wishing for victory, set to tear each other, pierced dreadful arrows on one another all over the limbs, opposing.

verses.sloka: अयोमुखैस्त्रिर्भिर्विद्ध्वा राक्षसेन्द्रं विभीषणम्।एकैकेनाभिविव्याध तान् सर्वान् हरियूथपान् ।। ६.९१.४० ।।
verses.transliteration: ayomukhaistrirbhirviddhvā rākṣasendraṁ vibhīṣaṇam।ekaikenābhivivyādha tān sarvān hariyūthapān ।। 6.91.40 ।।

translations.english: Then Ravana's son in his charming countenance, filled with wrath because of conflict, struck at Vibheeshana with three arrows.

verses.sloka: तस्मै दृढतरं क्रुद्धो जघान गदया हयान्।विभीषणो महातेजा रावणेः स दुरात्मनः ।। ६.९१.४१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasmai dṛḍhataraṁ kruddho jaghāna gadayā hayān।vibhīṣaṇo mahātejā rāvaṇeḥ sa durātmanaḥ ।। 6.91.41 ।।

translations.english: Having struck Vibheeshana with three arrows, he struck again all the Vanara leaders with one arrow each.

verses.sloka: स हताश्वादवप्लुत्य रथान्निहतसारथेः।रथशक्तिं महातेजाः पितृव्याय मुमोच ह ।। ६.९१.४२ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa hatāśvādavaplutya rathānnihatasāratheḥ।rathaśaktiṁ mahātejāḥ pitṛvyāya mumoca ha ।। 6.91.42 ।।

translations.english: Brilliant Vibheeshana struck evil minded Indrajith, his horses and elephants with his mace.

verses.sloka: तामापतन्तीं सम्प्रेक्ष्य सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः।चिच्छेद निशितैर्बाणैर्दशधा सा ऽपतद्भुवि ।। ६.९१.४३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tāmāpatantīṁ samprekṣya sumitrānandavardhanaḥ।ciccheda niśitairbāṇairdaśadhā sā 'patadbhuvi ।। 6.91.43 ।।

translations.english: Highly energetic Indrajith, leaping down from the chariot, horses destroyed, now hurled a javelin at his uncle in the chariot.

verses.sloka: तस्मै दृढधनुः क्रुद्धो हताश्वाय विभीषणः।वज्रस्पर्शसमान् पञ्च ससर्जोरसि मार्गणान् ।। ६.९१.४४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasmai dṛḍhadhanuḥ kruddho hatāśvāya vibhīṣaṇaḥ।vajrasparśasamān pañca sasarjorasi mārgaṇān ।। 6.91.44 ।।

translations.english: Observing the javelin coming towards him, Lakshmana, the delight of Raghus and enhancer of Sumithra's joy, split it into ten pieces, which had fallen on the ground.

verses.sloka: ते तस्य कायं निर्भिद्य रुक्मपुङ्खा निमित्तगाः।बभूवुर्लोहितादिग्धा रक्ता इव महोरगाः ।। ६.९१.४५ ।।
verses.transliteration: te tasya kāyaṁ nirbhidya rukmapuṅkhā nimittagāḥ।babhūvurlohitādigdhā raktā iva mahoragāḥ ।। 6.91.45 ।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana of strong body, pierced five arrows like thunderbolt in impact into the chest of Indrajith.

verses.sloka: स पितृव्याय सङ्क्रुद्ध इन्द्रजिच्छरमाददे।उत्तमं रक्षसां मध्ये यमदत्तं महाबलः ।। ६.९१.४६ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa pitṛvyāya saṅkruddha indrajiccharamādade।uttamaṁ rakṣasāṁ madhye yamadattaṁ mahābalaḥ ।। 6.91.46 ।।

translations.english: The arrows with red feathers of Vibheeshana having penetrated the body of Indrajith, piercing into the body they became red coloured seemed like a red serpent.

verses.sloka: तं समीक्ष्य महातेजा महेषुं तेन संहितम्।लक्ष्मणो ऽप्याददे बाणमन्यं भीमपराक्रमः ।। ६.९१.४७ ।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ samīkṣya mahātejā maheṣuṁ tena saṁhitam।lakṣmaṇo 'pyādade bāṇamanyaṁ bhīmaparākramaḥ ।। 6.91.47 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith, angry with his uncle, staying in the midst of Rakshasas, seized a mighty strong best arrow gifted by Yama.

verses.sloka: कुबेरेण स्वयं स्वप्ने स्वस्मै दत्तं महात्मना।दुर्जयं दुर्विषह्यं च सेन्द्रैरपि सुरासुरैः ।। ६.९१.४८ ।।
verses.transliteration: kubereṇa svayaṁ svapne svasmai dattaṁ mahātmanā।durjayaṁ durviṣahyaṁ ca sendrairapi surāsuraiḥ ।। 6.91.48 ।।

translations.english: Extraordinarily brilliant and of terrific valour, Lakshmana, perceiving the mighty shaft yoked by him (by Indrajith), he took up another arrow.

verses.sloka: तयोस्ते धनुषी श्रेष्ठे बाहुभिः परिघोपमैः।विकृष्यमाणे बलवत् क्रौञ्चाविव चुकूजतुः ।। ६.९१.४९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tayoste dhanuṣī śreṣṭhe bāhubhiḥ parighopamaiḥ।vikṛṣyamāṇe balavat krauñcāviva cukūjatuḥ ।। 6.91.49 ।।

translations.english: That arrow was gifted to Lakshmana in dream by Kubera, the god of wealth and even Suras or Asuras cannot resist it and is difficult to win.

verses.sloka: ताभ्यां तौ धनुषि श्रेष्ठे संहितौ सायकोत्तमौ।विकृष्यमाणौ वीराभ्यां भृशं जज्वलतुः श्रिया ।। ६.९१.५० ।।
verses.transliteration: tābhyāṁ tau dhanuṣi śreṣṭhe saṁhitau sāyakottamau।vikṛṣyamāṇau vīrābhyāṁ bhṛśaṁ jajvalatuḥ śriyā ।। 6.91.50 ।।

translations.english: Excellent bows of the two made noise like Krauncha birds while being drawn with great strength by the two, whose arms resembled iron bars.

verses.sloka: तौ भासयन्तावाकाशं धनुर्भ्यां विशिखौ च्युतौ।मुखेन मुखमाहत्य सन्निपेततुरोजसा ।। ६.९१.५१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tau bhāsayantāvākāśaṁ dhanurbhyāṁ viśikhau cyutau।mukhena mukhamāhatya sannipetaturojasā ।। 6.91.51 ।।

translations.english: The two best bows of both the heroes together, being powerful, shone with splendour when drawn with bowstring.

verses.sloka: सन्निपातस्तयोरासीच्छरयोर्घोररूपयोः।सधूमविस्फुलिङ्गश्च तज्जो ऽग्निर्दारुणो ऽभवत् ।। ६.९१.५२ ।।
verses.transliteration: sannipātastayorāsīccharayorghorarūpayoḥ।sadhūmavisphuliṅgaśca tajjo 'gnirdāruṇo 'bhavat ।। 6.91.52 ।।

translations.english: Those arrows released from the bows lit the sky when their heads collided with each other and glowed by rubbing against each other.

verses.sloka: तौ महाग्रहसङ्काशावन्योन्यं सन्निपत्य च।सङ्ग्रामे शतधा यान्तौ मेदिन्यां विनिपेततुः ।। ६.९१.५३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tau mahāgrahasaṅkāśāvanyonyaṁ sannipatya ca।saṅgrāme śatadhā yāntau medinyāṁ vinipetatuḥ ।। 6.91.53 ।।

translations.english: By the impact of the two arrows brought together, a formidable form of fire frightening with smoke and sparks was created.

verses.sloka: शरौ प्रतिहतौ दृष्ट्वा तावुभौ रणमूर्धनि।व्रीडितौ जातरोषौ च लक्ष्मणेन्द्रजितौ तदा ।। ६.९१.५४ ।।
verses.transliteration: śarau pratihatau dṛṣṭvā tāvubhau raṇamūrdhani।vrīḍitau jātaroṣau ca lakṣmaṇendrajitau tadā ।। 6.91.54 ।।

translations.english: In the battle both of them touching each other in conflict like the major planets flew into a hundred pieces and fell on earth.

verses.sloka: सुसंरब्धस्तु सौमित्रिरस्त्रं वारुणमाददे ।। ६.९१.५५ ।।
verses.transliteration: susaṁrabdhastu saumitrirastraṁ vāruṇamādade ।। 6.91.55 ।।

translations.english: Then both Lakshmana and Indrajith in the face of the battle seeing their arrows in nought with each other were abashed and got agitated.

verses.sloka: रौद्रं महेन्द्रजिद्युद्धे व्यसृजद्युधि निष्ठितः।तेन तद्विहतं त्वस्त्रं वारुणं परमाद्भुतम् ।। ६.९१.५६ ।।
verses.transliteration: raudraṁ mahendrajidyuddhe vyasṛjadyudhi niṣṭhitaḥ।tena tadvihataṁ tvastraṁ vāruṇaṁ paramādbhutam ।। 6.91.56 ।।

translations.english: Enraged Saumithri, seizing the weapon of Varuna, skilled in warfare loosened on Indrajith (Mahendra's enemy), which was presided over by Rudra.

verses.sloka: ततः क्रुद्धो महातेजा इन्द्रजित् समितिञ्जयः।आग्नेयं सन्दधे दीप्तं स लोकं सङ्क्षिपन्निव ।। ६.९१.५७ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kruddho mahātejā indrajit samitiñjayaḥ।āgneyaṁ sandadhe dīptaṁ sa lokaṁ saṅkṣipanniva ।। 6.91.57 ।।

translations.english: Then the very wonderful weapon of Varuna was made ineffective by the highly energetic Indrajith's who used glowing fire missiles as if to destroy the whole world.

verses.sloka: सौरेणास्त्रेण तद्वीरो लक्ष्मणः प्रत्यवारयत् ।। ६.९१.५८ ।।
verses.transliteration: saureṇāstreṇa tadvīro lakṣmaṇaḥ pratyavārayat ।। 6.91.58 ।।

translations.english: Then the very wonderful weapon of Varuna was made ineffective by the highly energetic Indrajith's who used glowing fire missiles as if to destroy the whole world.

verses.sloka: अस्त्रं निवारितं दृष्ट्वा रावणिः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः।आसुरं शत्रुनाशाय घोरमस्त्रं समाददे ।। ६.९१.५९ ।।
verses.transliteration: astraṁ nivāritaṁ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇiḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ।āsuraṁ śatrunāśāya ghoramastraṁ samādade ।। 6.91.59 ।।

translations.english: Then Lakshmana used a Sun missile and repelled (Indrajith's fire missile). Seeing his missile obstructed, Indrajith deluded with anger used a sharp Asura missile capable of destroying the enemy.

verses.sloka: तस्माच्चापाद्विनिष्पेतुर्भास्वराः कूटमुद्गराः।शूलानि च भुशुण्ड्यश्च गदाः खड्गाः परश्वधाः ।। ६.९१.६० ।।
verses.transliteration: tasmāccāpādviniṣpeturbhāsvarāḥ kūṭamudgarāḥ।śūlāni ca bhuśuṇḍyaśca gadāḥ khaḍgāḥ paraśvadhāḥ ।। 6.91.60 ।।

translations.english: By the Sun missile, the Kutamudgaras, tridents, Bhusundas, swords and axes issued forth from Indrajith's bow.

verses.sloka: तद्दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणः सङ्ख्ये घोरमस्त्रमथासुरम्।अवार्यं सर्वभूतानां सर्वशत्रुविनाशनम्।माहेश्वरेण द्युतिमांस्तदस्त्रं प्रत्यवारयत् ।। ६.९१.६१ ।।
verses.transliteration: taddṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇaḥ saṅkhye ghoramastramathāsuram।avāryaṁ sarvabhūtānāṁ sarvaśatruvināśanam।māheśvareṇa dyutimāṁstadastraṁ pratyavārayat ।। 6.91.61 ।।

translations.english: Effulgent Lakshmana, seeing the terrible Asura missile and deliberating that it is capable of destroying all human beings and difficult to repel, used a Maheswara missile to divert.

verses.sloka: तयोः सुतुमुलं युद्धं सम्बभूवाद्भुतोपमम्।गगनस्थानि भूतानि लक्ष्मणं पर्यवारयन् ।। ६.९१.६२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tayoḥ sutumulaṁ yuddhaṁ sambabhūvādbhutopamam।gaganasthāni bhūtāni lakṣmaṇaṁ paryavārayan ।। 6.91.62 ।।

translations.english: Effulgent Lakshmana, seeing the terrible Asura missile and deliberating that it is capable of destroying all human beings and difficult to repel, used a Maheswara missile to divert.

verses.sloka: भैरवाभिरुते भीमे युद्धे वानररक्षसाम्।भूतैर्बहुभिराकाशं विस्मितैरावृतं बभौ ।। ६.९१.६३ ।।
verses.transliteration: bhairavābhirute bhīme yuddhe vānararakṣasām।bhūtairbahubhirākāśaṁ vismitairāvṛtaṁ babhau ।। 6.91.63 ।।

translations.english: The war between both was wonderful and horripulating. Beings from the sky saw Lakshmana diverting the Asura missile.

verses.sloka: ऋषयः पितरो देवा गन्धर्वा गरुडोरगाः।शतक्रतुं पुरस्कृत्य ररक्षुर्लक्ष्मणं रणे ।। ६.९१.६४ ।।
verses.transliteration: ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā gandharvā garuḍoragāḥ।śatakratuṁ puraskṛtya rarakṣurlakṣmaṇaṁ raṇe ।। 6.91.64 ।।

translations.english: As the frightful war between Vanaras and Rakshasas went on, many beings surrounded in the sky were astonished and looked charming.

verses.sloka: अथान्यं मार्गणश्रेष्ठं सन्दधे राघवानुजः।हुताशनसमस्पर्शं रावणात्मजदारणम् ।। ६.९१.६५ ।।
verses.transliteration: athānyaṁ mārgaṇaśreṣṭhaṁ sandadhe rāghavānujaḥ।hutāśanasamasparśaṁ rāvaṇātmajadāraṇam ।। 6.91.65 ।।

translations.english: The Rsis, Devatas, manes, Gandharvas, Garudas, serpents and Indra who had performed hundred sacrifices, protected Lakshmana in war.

verses.sloka: सुपत्रमनुवृत्ताङ्गं सुपर्वाणं सुसंस्थितम्।सुवर्णविकृतं वीरः शरीरान्तकरं शरम् ।। ६.९१.६६ ।।
verses.transliteration: supatramanuvṛttāṅgaṁ suparvāṇaṁ susaṁsthitam।suvarṇavikṛtaṁ vīraḥ śarīrāntakaraṁ śaram ।। 6.91.66 ।।

translations.english: And thereafter, Raghava's brother fitted another excellent arrow which had the impact of the touch of fire capable of tearing Indrajith.

verses.sloka: दुरावारं दुर्विषह्यं राक्षसानां भयावहम्।आशीविषविषप्रख्यं देवसङ्घैः समर्चितम् ।। ६.९१.६७ ।।
verses.transliteration: durāvāraṁ durviṣahyaṁ rākṣasānāṁ bhayāvaham।āśīviṣaviṣaprakhyaṁ devasaṅghaiḥ samarcitam ।। 6.91.67 ।।

translations.english: The arrow with lovely feathers, consisting of beautiful parts, skilfully done, well jointed, decked with gold, was not only difficult to put off but also difficult to bear, was capable of destroying enemies, frightful, resembling venomous serpents, and worshipped by gods.

verses.sloka: येन शक्रो महातेजा दानवानजयत् प्रभुः।पुरा दैवासुरे युद्धे वीर्यवान् हरिवाहनः ।। ६.९१.६८ ।।
verses.transliteration: yena śakro mahātejā dānavānajayat prabhuḥ।purā daivāsure yuddhe vīryavān harivāhanaḥ ।। 6.91.68 ।।

translations.english: The arrow with lovely feathers, consisting of beautiful parts, skilfully done, well jointed, decked with gold, was not only difficult to put off but also difficult to bear, was capable of destroying enemies, frightful, resembling venomous serpents, and worshipped by gods.

verses.sloka: तदैन्द्रमस्त्रं सौमित्रिः संयुगेष्वपराजितम्।शरश्रेष्ठं धनुः श्रेष्ठे नरश्रेष्ठो ऽभिसन्दधे ।। ६.९१.६९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tadaindramastraṁ saumitriḥ saṁyugeṣvaparājitam।śaraśreṣṭhaṁ dhanuḥ śreṣṭhe naraśreṣṭho 'bhisandadhe ।। 6.91.69 ।।

translations.english: In the past at the war between Devas and Asuras, a mighty and energetic valiant Lord of Devas who had green horses conquered Danavas (with the same sword).

verses.sloka: सन्धायामित्रदलनं विचकर्ष शरासनम्।सज्यमायम्य दुर्धर्षं कालो लोकक्षये यथा ।। ६.९१.७० ।।
verses.transliteration: sandhāyāmitradalanaṁ vicakarṣa śarāsanam।sajyamāyamya durdharṣaṁ kālo lokakṣaye yathā ।। 6.91.70 ।।

translations.english: Son of Saumithri, that prosperous Lakshmana, drawing Indra's missile, the foremost one, and also the best of arrows, which has never been defeated, spoke these words set to achieve the purpose.

verses.sloka: सन्धाय धनुषि श्रेष्ठे विकर्षन्निदमब्रवीत्।लक्ष्मीवाँल्लक्ष्मणो वाक्यमर्थसाधकमात्मनः ।। ६.९१.७१ ।।
verses.transliteration: sandhāya dhanuṣi śreṣṭhe vikarṣannidamabravīt।lakṣmīvām̐llakṣmaṇo vākyamarthasādhakamātmanaḥ ।। 6.91.71 ।।

translations.english: "If Dasharatha's son, Sri Rama is righteous, truthful, of unrivalled valour and true to his promise this arrow will kill Indrajith."

verses.sloka: धर्मात्मा सत्यसन्धश्च रामो दाशरथिर्यदि।पौरुषे चाप्रतिद्वन्द्वः शरैनं जहि रावणिम् ।। ६.९१.७२ ।।
verses.transliteration: dharmātmā satyasandhaśca rāmo dāśarathiryadi।pauruṣe cāpratidvandvaḥ śarainaṁ jahi rāvaṇim ।। 6.91.72 ।।

translations.english: Having spoken that way, Lakshmana, heroic in battle, bending the bow, stretching the arrow till the ear released on Indrajith.

verses.sloka: इत्युक्त्वा बाणमाकर्णं विकृष्य तमजिह्मगम्।लक्ष्मणः समरे वीरः ससर्जेन्द्रजितं प्रति।ऐन्द्रास्त्रेण समायोज्य लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा ।। ६.९१.७३ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā bāṇamākarṇaṁ vikṛṣya tamajihmagam।lakṣmaṇaḥ samare vīraḥ sasarjendrajitaṁ prati।aindrāstreṇa samāyojya lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā ।। 6.91.73 ।।

translations.english: Prosperous Lakshmana, the destroyer of enemies, aiming at Indrajith's head shining with earrings belonging to the head severed from the body, it fell on ground.

verses.sloka: स शिरः सशिरस्त्राणं श्रीमज्ज्वलितकुण्डलम्।प्रमथ्येन्द्रजितः कायात् पातयामास भूतले ।। ६.९१.७४ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa śiraḥ saśirastrāṇaṁ śrīmajjvalitakuṇḍalam।pramathyendrajitaḥ kāyāt pātayāmāsa bhūtale ।। 6.91.74 ।।

translations.english: Prosperous Lakshmana, the destroyer of enemies, aiming at Indrajith's head shining with earrings belonging to the head severed from the body, it fell on ground.

verses.sloka: तद्राक्षसतनूजस्य छिन्नस्कन्धं शिरो महत्।तपनीयनिभं भूमौ ददृशे रुधिरोक्षितम् ।। ६.९१.७५ ।।
verses.transliteration: tadrākṣasatanūjasya chinnaskandhaṁ śiro mahat।tapanīyanibhaṁ bhūmau dadṛśe rudhirokṣitam ।। 6.91.75 ।।

translations.english: Trunk broken off, the huge head of Indrajith bathed in blood was seen on the earth shining like gold.

verses.sloka: हतस्तु निपपाताशु धरण्यां रावणात्मजः।कवची सशिरस्त्राणो विध्वस्तः सशरासनः ।। ६.९१.७६ ।।
verses.transliteration: hatastu nipapātāśu dharaṇyāṁ rāvaṇātmajaḥ।kavacī saśirastrāṇo vidhvastaḥ saśarāsanaḥ ।। 6.91.76 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter Indrajith with his shield, and helmet of the head broken was thrown on earth killed.

verses.sloka: चुक्रुशुस्ते ततः सर्वे वानराः सविभीषणाः।हृष्यन्तो निहते तस्मिन् देवा वृत्रवधे यथा ।। ६.९१.७७ ।।
verses.transliteration: cukruśuste tataḥ sarve vānarāḥ savibhīṣaṇāḥ।hṛṣyanto nihate tasmin devā vṛtravadhe yathā ।। 6.91.77 ।।

translations.english: Then Vibheeshana and all the Vanaras rejoiced just as Devas, when Vrtasura was killed.

verses.sloka: अथान्तरिक्षे देवानामृषीणां च महात्मनाम्।अभिजज्ञे च सन्नादो गन्धर्वाप्सरसामपि ।। ६.९१.७८ ।।
verses.transliteration: athāntarikṣe devānāmṛṣīṇāṁ ca mahātmanām।abhijajñe ca sannādo gandharvāpsarasāmapi ।। 6.91.78 ।।

translations.english: Then shouts of victory aroused from the heavens from the created beings of heaven, Rsis also, Gandharvas and Apsaras.

verses.sloka: पतितं तमभिज्ञाय राक्षसी सा महाचमूः।वध्यमाना दिशो भेजे हरिभिर्जितकाशिभिः ।। ६.९१.७९ ।।
verses.transliteration: patitaṁ tamabhijñāya rākṣasī sā mahācamūḥ।vadhyamānā diśo bheje haribhirjitakāśibhiḥ ।। 6.91.79 ।।

translations.english: Great army of Rakshasas even though desired to win seeing (Indrajith dead), Vanaras started attacking them. Unable to bear Rakshasas screamed.

verses.sloka: वानरैर्वध्यमानास्ते शस्त्राण्युत्सृज्य राक्षसाः।लङ्कामभिमुखाः सस्त्रुर्नष्टसञ्ज्ञाः प्रधाविताः ।। ६.९१.८० ।।
verses.transliteration: vānarairvadhyamānāste śastrāṇyutsṛjya rākṣasāḥ।laṅkāmabhimukhāḥ sastrurnaṣṭasañjñāḥ pradhāvitāḥ ।। 6.91.80 ।।

translations.english: Those Rakshasas being killed by Vanaras, went running to Lanka leaving their weapons, with senses lost.

verses.sloka: दुद्रुवुर्बहुधा भीता राक्षसाः शतशो दिशः।त्यक्त्वा प्रहरणान् सर्वे पट्टिशासिपरश्वधान् ।। ६.९१.८१ ।।
verses.transliteration: dudruvurbahudhā bhītā rākṣasāḥ śataśo diśaḥ।tyaktvā praharaṇān sarve paṭṭiśāsiparaśvadhān ।। 6.91.81 ।।

translations.english: All Rakshasas feared and panic stricken fled in hundreds, in groups in all directions leaving their sharpedged spears, swords, and axes.

verses.sloka: केचिल्लङ्कां परित्रस्ताः प्रविष्टा वानरार्दिताः।समुद्रे पतिताः केचित् केचित् पर्वतमाश्रिताः ।। ६.९१.८२ ।।
verses.transliteration: kecillaṅkāṁ paritrastāḥ praviṣṭā vānarārditāḥ।samudre patitāḥ kecit kecit parvatamāśritāḥ ।। 6.91.82 ।।

translations.english: Pained by Vanaras, some fearful entered Lanka, few had fallen in the ocean and some sought refuge in the mountain.

verses.sloka: हतमिन्द्रजितं दृष्ट्वा शयानं समरक्षितौ।राक्षसानां सहस्रेषु न कश्चित् प्रत्यदृश्यत ।। ६.९१.८३ ।।
verses.transliteration: hatamindrajitaṁ dṛṣṭvā śayānaṁ samarakṣitau।rākṣasānāṁ sahasreṣu na kaścit pratyadṛśyata ।। 6.91.83 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith was lying, having fallen on the ground, and not even one of the thousands of Rakshasas was present there to see.

verses.sloka: यथा ऽस्तं गत आदित्ये नावतिष्ठन्ति रश्मयः।तथा तस्मिन्निपतिते राक्षसास्ते गता दिशः ।। ६.९१.८४ ।।
verses.transliteration: yathā 'staṁ gata āditye nāvatiṣṭhanti raśmayaḥ।tathā tasminnipatite rākṣasāste gatā diśaḥ ।। 6.91.84 ।।

translations.english: Just as Sun rays go away as soon as the Sun sets in the evening, the Rakshasas also went in all directions seeing Indrajith fallen.

verses.sloka: शान्तरश्मिरिवादित्यो निर्वाण इव पावकः।स बभूव महातेजा व्यपास्तगतजीवितः ।। ६.९१.८५ ।।
verses.transliteration: śāntaraśmirivādityo nirvāṇa iva pāvakaḥ।sa babhūva mahātejā vyapāstagatajīvitaḥ ।। 6.91.85 ।।

translations.english: Shorn of life, the broad shouldered Indrajith remained on the ground like the Sun whose rays have become cool, after death.

verses.sloka: प्रशान्तपीडाबहुलो नष्टारिष्टः प्रतापवान्।बभूव लोकः पतिते राक्षसेन्द्रसुते तदा ।। ६.९१.८६ ।।
verses.transliteration: praśāntapīḍābahulo naṣṭāriṣṭaḥ pratāpavān।babhūva lokaḥ patite rākṣasendrasute tadā ।। 6.91.86 ।।

translations.english: Then many were at peace and rejoiced in the world, being relieved, when Ravana's son dropped dead.

verses.sloka: हर्षं च शक्रो भगवान् सह सर्वैः सुरर्षभैः।जगाम निहते तस्मिन् राक्षसे पापकर्मणि ।। ६.९१.८७ ।।
verses.transliteration: harṣaṁ ca śakro bhagavān saha sarvaiḥ surarṣabhaiḥ।jagāma nihate tasmin rākṣase pāpakarmaṇi ।। 6.91.87 ।।

translations.english: Glorious Rakshasa of sinful deeds having been killed, all including great sages and Indra felt rejoiced.

verses.transliteration: ākāśe cāpi devānāṁ śuśruve dundubhisvanaḥ ।। 6.91.88 ।।

translations.english: In heaven also, sounds of drums of Gandharvas, great souls and dance of Apsaras were heard.

verses.sloka: नृत्यद्भिरप्सरोभिश्च गन्धर्वैश्च महात्मभिः ।। ६.९१.८९ ।।
verses.transliteration: nṛtyadbhirapsarobhiśca gandharvaiśca mahātmabhiḥ ।। 6.91.89 ।।

translations.english: With cruel minded Rakshasa killed, celebrities showered rain of flowers praising the wonderful deed.

verses.sloka: ववृषुः पुष्पवर्षाणि तदद्भुतमभूत्तदा।प्रशशंसुर्हते तस्मिन् राक्षसे क्रूरकर्मणि ।। ६.९१.९० ।।
verses.transliteration: vavṛṣuḥ puṣpavarṣāṇi tadadbhutamabhūttadā।praśaśaṁsurhate tasmin rākṣase krūrakarmaṇi ।। 6.91.90 ।।

translations.english: As the terror of all worlds had fallen and the water from the sky became pure, Devas and Danavas rejoiced and came there.

verses.sloka: शुद्धा आपो दिशश्चैव जहृषुर्दैत्यदानवाः ।। ६.९१.९१ ।।
verses.transliteration: śuddhā āpo diśaścaiva jahṛṣurdaityadānavāḥ ।। 6.91.91 ।।

translations.english: Devas, Danavas and Ghandharvas arrived there and said, "Let the Brahmins be without anxiety and move about without fear."

verses.sloka: आजग्मुः पतिते तस्मिन् सर्वलोकभयावहे।ऊचुश्च सहिताः सर्वे देवगन्धर्वदानवाः।विज्वराः शान्तकलुषा ब्राह्मणा विचरन्त्विति ।। ६.९१.९२ ।।
verses.transliteration: ājagmuḥ patite tasmin sarvalokabhayāvahe।ūcuśca sahitāḥ sarve devagandharvadānavāḥ।vijvarāḥ śāntakaluṣā brāhmaṇā vicarantviti ।। 6.91.92 ।।

translations.english: When, the best of Rakshasa, a leader of extraordinary prowess was killed, the Vanara army seeing Lakshmana felt happy and greeted him.

verses.sloka: ततो ऽभ्यनन्दन् संहृष्टाः समरे हरियूथपाः।तमप्रतिबलं दृष्ट्वा हतं नैर्ऋतपुङ्गवम् ।। ६.९१.९३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato 'bhyanandan saṁhṛṣṭāḥ samare hariyūthapāḥ।tamapratibalaṁ dṛṣṭvā hataṁ nairṛtapuṅgavam ।। 6.91.93 ।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana and Hanuman, leader of Bears Jambavan praised Lakshmana and greeted him for his victory.

verses.sloka: विभीषणो हनूमांश्च जाम्बवांश्चर्क्षयूथपः।विजयेनाभिनन्दन्तस्तुष्टुवुश्चापि लक्ष्मणम् ।। ६.९१.९४ ।।
verses.transliteration: vibhīṣaṇo hanūmāṁśca jāmbavāṁścarkṣayūthapaḥ।vijayenābhinandantastuṣṭuvuścāpi lakṣmaṇam ।। 6.91.94 ।।

translations.english: Having accomplished their goal, monkeys roaring, playing, surrounded Lakshmana, and stood.

verses.sloka: क्ष्वेलन्तश्च नदन्तश्च गर्जन्तश्च प्लवङ्गमाः।लब्धलक्षा रघुसुतं परिवार्योपतस्थिरे ।। ६.९१.९५ ।।
verses.transliteration: kṣvelantaśca nadantaśca garjantaśca plavaṅgamāḥ।labdhalakṣā raghusutaṁ parivāryopatasthire ।। 6.91.95 ।।

translations.english: Then Vanaras wagging their tails and lashing them announced slogans saying," Lakshmana is winning."

verses.sloka: लाङ्गूलानि प्रविध्यन्तः स्फोटयन्तश्च वानराः।लक्ष्मणो जयतीत्येवं वाक्यं विश्रावयंस्तदा ।। ६.९१.९६ ।।
verses.transliteration: lāṅgūlāni pravidhyantaḥ sphoṭayantaśca vānarāḥ।lakṣmaṇo jayatītyevaṁ vākyaṁ viśrāvayaṁstadā ।। 6.91.96 ।।

translations.english: The monkeys feeling very happy embraced one another singing in praise of Lakshmana saying" Lakshmana has won"and stories related to Lakshmana

verses.sloka: अन्योन्यं च समाश्लिष्य कपयो हृष्टमानसाः।चक्रुरुच्चावचगुणा राघवाश्रयजाः कथाः ।। ६.९१.९७ ।।
verses.transliteration: anyonyaṁ ca samāśliṣya kapayo hṛṣṭamānasāḥ।cakruruccāvacaguṇā rāghavāśrayajāḥ kathāḥ ।। 6.91.97 ।।

translations.english: Beholding that arduous feat of Lakshmana in battle, his dear friends rejoiced; and the gods too, hearing that the enemy of Indra had been struck down, felt supreme delight of heart.

verses.sloka: तदसुकरमथाभिवीक्ष्य हृष्टाः प्रियसुहृदो युधि लक्ष्मणस्य कर्म।परममुपलभन् मनः प्रहर्षं विनिहतमिन्द्ररिपुं निशम्य देवाः ।। ६.९१.९८ ।।
verses.transliteration: tadasukaramathābhivīkṣya hṛṣṭāḥ priyasuhṛdo yudhi lakṣmaṇasya karma।paramamupalabhan manaḥ praharṣaṁ vinihatamindraripuṁ niśamya devāḥ ।। 6.91.98 ।।

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे एकनवतितमः सर्गः ।। ९१ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe ekanavatitamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 91 ।।
